hexagonal_lattice.definition: T(h,k) = h^2 + hk + k^2 triangulation number on hexagonal grid

chiral_classification.definition: MC (h=0 or k=0), BG (h=k), Ch1-Ch5 (chiral with h!=k)
chiral_classification.deviation: Chiral subcategories assigned by ratio thresholds (approximate)

growth_simulation.definition: Monte Carlo deposition with path probability weights
growth_simulation.deviation: Simplified energy model using LJ + mismatch penalty
